normalization.trajectory_per_quantity: max_t(abs(qssa-full))/max(max_t(abs(full)),1e-12); report raw errors and scales too
normalization.invariant_per_quantity: max_t(abs(B(t)-B(0)))/max(1,abs(B(0))); I6 initial zero uses scale 1
normalization.physicality: 64*eps(max([1;abs(initial augmented state);abs(initial invariants)])) uM, inherited D6 convention; also check E_T-M

accounting: Synchronously integrate D_nt and D_TLcat; no feedback. Explicit invariants include M in B_NTP and B_AA; QSSA has corresponding coarse invariants without h(s).
initialization: Same canonical 10 slow initial states in both models; full M0=h(y0). Full NTP and AA totals exceed reduced coarse totals by M0; no initial-state adjustment or projection.
repository_regression: Every new and existing MATLAB test Passed; Failed=0; Incomplete=0; run full suite again before final commit.
evidence_limit: Engineering gates for this synthetic profile only; not a universal QSSA theorem or experimental validity.
failure_policy: Retain every formal run. Fix implementation or numerical issues with revision records, unchanged scientific equations and thresholds. Confirmed scientific failure prohibits D7 COMPLETE.
